newsitem.title: JAPAN: Barclays, Hokkaido Takushoku to announce tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Barclays, Hokkaido Takushoku to announce tie-up.

text.p: Barclays group and Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd will brief the media at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) on Monday on a business tie-up, spokesmen for the firms said.
Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd announced in April that it and regional bank Hokkaido Bank Ltd plan to merge in April 1998 with the aim of becoming a "super-regional" bank.
Both are headquartered in Sapporo, the largest city on Japan's northern island of Hokkaido.

Hokkaido Takushoku said earlier this year that the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) had agreed to help Hokkaido Takushoku withdraw from overseas operations, although this did not mean that LTCB would buy Hokkaido Takushoku's overseas assets.
Hokkaido Takushoku also said at that time that it plans to refer customers at its securities subsidiaries in Switzerland and London to LTCB.
Hokkaido Takushoku had 20 overseas offices, including six branches and five subsidiaries, when it announced the merger plan.
